entry_rules: Zero rows until an authorized first-party report supplies the numbers. No estimates, no forecasts, no modeled conversion scores.
Every row requires: timestamp (UTC), source (the report it came from), channel, eligible sessions, clicks, reported orders, and a provenance link or report identifier.
Values obtained from Amazon Associates reports are entered exactly as reported, with the report date recorded.
Rows are append-only; corrections are added as new rows with a note referencing the row being corrected.
This ledger never contains personally identifiable visitor data.

columns.label: Source
columns.definition: Authorised first-party report the numbers came from
columns.source_of_truth: Report name, e.g. Amazon Associates Report

columns.label: Channel
columns.definition: Where the traffic came from (site, rss, search, social, email)

columns.label: Eligible sessions
columns.definition: Sessions eligible for attribution in the window

columns.label: Clicks
columns.definition: Clicks recorded on outbound product links

columns.label: Reported orders
columns.definition: Orders as reported by the associate program

columns.label: Provenance
columns.definition: Link or identifier of the underlying report
